Sam authorized the 0.4.5 release in chat on 2026-11-24.

The 0.4.5 version is in package.json, package-lock.json, server.json, both assistant-guide manifests, CHANGELOG.md and RELEASE_NOTES-v0.4.5.md. The source candidate base is documentation commit e5decc822f02d469b6bf4780ecd98041448178e2. Full npm run check passed locally with the sibling Obligation-First checkout.

The clean-consumer npm pack/install evaluation passed: ai-incident-law@0.4.5, 380 packed files, archive SHA-256 f90f9cf00e5c07f26091e7094f491bc253ddc25255e21ad3ab24e9505ff7eaa7, eight MCP tools.
